dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, were you afraid of anything when you were a child?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, wɜːr juː əˈfreɪd əv ˈɛniθɪŋ wɛn juː wɜːr ə ˈtʃaɪld?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I was afraid of the dark. I used to sleep with the light on.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ wʌz əˈfreɪd əv ðə ˈdɑːrk. aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈsliːp wɪð ðə ˈlaɪt ˈɑːn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Why? Were you afraid of ghosts?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaɪ? wɜːr juː əˈfreɪd əv ˈɡoʊsts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! My cousins used to talk about ghosts at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! maɪ ˈkʌzənz ˈjuːst tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˈɡoʊsts ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! I used to think there was a monster under my bed.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈθɪŋk ðɛr wʌz ə ˈmɑːnstər ˈʌndər maɪ ˈbɛd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was afraid of needles, too. I didn't use to like doctors at all!
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz əˈfreɪd əv ˈniːdəlz, ˈtuː. aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈjuːs tə ˈlaɪk ˈdɑːktərz ət ˈɔːl!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Me neither. And I didn't use to eat vegetables.
dialogue.reading: miː ˈniːðər. ənd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈjuːs tə ˈiːt ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I know! People change. Are you afraid of the dark now?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ! ˈpiːpəl ˈtʃeɪndʒ. ər juː əˈfreɪd əv ðə ˈdɑːrk ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I'm not. But I never watch ghost movies!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪm ˈnɑːt. bʌt aɪ ˈnɛvər ˈwɑːtʃ ˈɡoʊst ˈmuːviz!
